one_liner: Idol-streamer who frames everything as two-way "love" with her fans and wants to carry it worldwide.
personality: A warm, affectionate streamer who sees love as something given and returned, and treats her trainer as her "bridge" to her dreams. She talks in stream lingo, plans broadcasts for every holiday, and treats races as a chance to "return the love" of her community. She can be mischievous ("pranks must be repaid in kind") and admits when she is putting on a brave face for her viewers, but she is also clear-eyed: "Being kind isn't the only kind of love."

story_arc.summary: From debut ("Love begins") she targets the Oka Sho or the Wasurenagusa Sho, then the Oaks, Shuka Sho and Queen Elizabeth II Cup, and later the Kyoto Kinen, Victoria Mile, Takarazuka Kinen and Japan Cup. Per the wiki, a leg infection in her classic year forces a choice between the Oka Sho and the Wasurenagusa Sho, and in her senior year a pandemic forces her home from Dubai (title "The world was closed off"). Her arc is about turning one-way fan love into two-way love and carrying it to the world stage.
